chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The best of supplications is seeking forgiveness.'
ai.seo_question: What is considered the best form of supplication in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In Al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this concise yet profound tradition where Imam al-Sadiq (AS) attributes to the Prophet (PBUH) the designation of Istighfar as the 'best of supplications.' This ranking underscores the centrality of repentance in Shia spirituality, not merely as a remedy for sin, but as a continuous state of humility and connection with the Divine that encompasses all other forms of worship. The emphasis on Istighfar reflects the theological view that acknowledging one's need for God is the highest form of servitude.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The best of the supplications is the seeking of Forgiveness’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘The best prayer and plea before Allah for help is the plea for forgiveness and protection against the consequences of sins.’”
